exposure: Age group (term neonates, late preterm infants, healthy adults)
cohort: The study included cord blood from 57 term infants and 9 late preterm infants, and peripheral blood from 18 healthy adult donors.
finding: Healthy term infants exhibited lower NET percentage and NET area compared to adult controls, and NET formation was further decreased in late preterm neonates compared to term infants.
cross-section timing: At birth (for neonates) and a single time point (for adults)
birth_weight: N/A (investigated but specific weights not provided for cohort)
gest_age: Mean 39.1 weeks for term infants, 35 weeks for late preterm infants
